parameters.query:
UPDATE email_sends
   SET send_to        = $2,
       status         = CASE WHEN status = 'sent' THEN 'pending' ELSE status END,
       sent_at        = CASE WHEN status = 'sent' THEN NULL ELSE sent_at END,
       next_action_at = CASE WHEN status = 'sent' THEN now()  ELSE next_action_at END,
       updated_at     = now()
 WHERE customer_id = $1
   AND notification_type IN ('welcome', 'heads_up')
   AND status IN ('pending', 'sent')
   AND $2 <> ''
   AND send_to IS DISTINCT FROM $2
